scope: CALIBRATION; literature and read-only contracts; no fitting or ROI experiment

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.finding: Positive shared temperature preserves argmax; held-out NLL fit changes confidence; vision/NLP evidence, not sports ROI.

sources.title: Beta calibration: a well-founded and easily implemented improvement on logistic calibration for binary classifiers
sources.finding: Beta contains identity; isotonic risks small-sample overfit; binary result does not validate multiclass renormalization.

sources.title: Machine learning for sports betting: should model selection be based on accuracy or calibration?
sources.finding: NBA single evaluation season; original headline returns must be read with 2025 correction.

sources.title: Corrigendum to Machine learning for sports betting: should model selection be based on accuracy or calibration?
sources.finding: Feature engineering implementation errors affected downstream results. Corrected average ROI calibration -9.77%, accuracy -26.78%; best 23.13% vs 10.9%; eighth-Kelly -42.67% vs -64.45%. Paper metrics, not our ROI.

sources.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
sources.finding: Strict propriety elicits true distributions in expectation; finite-sample score gains neither prove perfect calibration nor profits.

sources.title: A Reality Check for Data Snooping
sources.finding: Benchmark superiority after specification search needs family-aware inference; dependence and regularity assumptions matter, especially with very few dates.
